Q1.purpose: Compare total refund amount and number of refunds in August vs September 2026
Q1.sql:
SELECT date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
       SUM(amount_usd) AS total_refund_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS refund_count
FROM WHYDROP_PG.refunds
WHERE date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
GROUP BY date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM')
ORDER BY month

Q2.purpose: Count support tickets and break down by category for August vs September 2026
Q2.sql:
SELECT date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS ticket_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN category = 'technical' THEN ticket_id END) AS technical_tickets,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN category = 'billing' THEN ticket_id END) AS billing_tickets
FROM WHYDROP_PG.support_tickets
WHERE date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
GROUP BY date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM')
ORDER BY month

Q3.purpose: Compute gross order revenue, total refunds, and net revenue for August vs September 2026
Q3.sql:
SELECT date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
       SUM(o.unit_price_usd * o.quantity) AS gross_revenue,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_usd), 0) AS total_refunds,
       SUM(o.unit_price_usd * o.quantity) - COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
LEFT JOIN WHYDROP_PG.refunds r
  ON o.order_id = r.order_id
 AND date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') = date_format(to_date(r.date), 'yyyy-MM')
WHERE date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
GROUP BY date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM')
ORDER BY month

Q5.purpose: Compare average unit price and revenue per order for those products in August vs September 2026
Q5.sql:
WITH affected_products AS (
  SELECT product_id
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.pricing_changes
  WHERE to_date(date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') BETWEEN to_date('2026-08-01', 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND to_date('2026-09-30', 'yyyy-MM-dd')
)
SELECT 
  date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
  AVG(CAST(o.unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_unit_price,
  SUM(CAST(o.unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * CAST(o.quantity AS DOUBLE)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS revenue_per_order
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
JOIN affected_products ap ON o.product_id = ap.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.date < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

Q8.sql_original:
SELECT
  month,
  SUM(spend_usd) AS total_spend,
  SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks,
  SUM(spend_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(clicks),0) AS cpc
FROM (
  SELECT
    date_format(date, 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
    spend_usd,
    clicks
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.marketing_spend
  WHERE channel = 'meta'
    AND date >= '2026-08-01'
    AND date <= '2026-09-30'
) ms
JOIN (
  SELECT
    date_format(date, 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
    clicks
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.web_traffic
  WHERE source = 'paid_social'
    AND date >= '2026-08-01'
    AND date <= '2026-09-30'
) wt
  ON ms.month = wt.month
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

Q11.purpose: Average order value and revenue change by source
Q11.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT date_format(to_date(t.date),'yyyy-MM') AS month,
         t.source,
         SUM(t.sessions) AS total_sessions,
         COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders,
         SUM(o.unit_price_usd * o.quantity) AS total_revenue
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.web_traffic t
  JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
    ON date_format(to_date(t.date),'yyyy-MM') = date_format(to_date(o.date),'yyyy-MM')
   AND date_format(to_date(t.date),'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
  GROUP BY month, t.source
)
SELECT month,
       source,
       total_sessions,
       total_orders,
       total_revenue,
       LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue,
       CASE WHEN LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY month) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE (total_revenue - LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY month)) / LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY month)
       END AS revenue_pct_change
FROM monthly
ORDER BY source, month;

Q12.purpose: Revenue per country for August vs September 2026
Q12.sql:
SELECT country,

Q13.purpose: Percent change in revenue by country and flag declines
Q13.sql:
SELECT country,
       (rev_sep - rev_aug) / rev_aug * 100.0 AS pct_change,
       CASE WHEN (rev_sep - rev_aug) / rev_aug * 100.0 < 0 THEN 'decline' ELSE 'increase' END AS trend
FROM (
    SELECT country,
           SUM(CASE WHEN date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') = '2026-08' THEN unit_price_usd * quantity ELSE 0 END) AS rev_aug,
           SUM(CASE WHEN date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') = '2026-09' THEN unit_price_usd * quantity ELSE 0 END) AS rev_sep
    FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders
    WHERE date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
    GROUP BY country
) t
ORDER BY pct_change ASC

Q16.purpose: Compare average unit_price_usd for products with a new release in September versus existing products
Q16.sql:
WITH sep_release AS (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM WHYDROP_FILES.release_log
    WHERE date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') = '2026-09'
),
orders_aug_sep AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
           CAST(unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) AS unit_price_usd,
           quantity
    FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders
    WHERE date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
)
SELECT CASE WHEN sr.product_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'new_release' ELSE 'existing' END AS category,
       AVG(o.unit_price_usd) AS avg_unit_price_usd
FROM orders_aug_sep o
LEFT JOIN sep_release sr ON o.product_id = sr.product_id
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;

Q17.purpose: Compare revenue distribution by product price quartile (high vs low) for August and September
Q17.sql:
WITH base_price AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           base_price,
           NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY base_price) AS price_quartile
    FROM WHYDROP_FILES.products
),
order_revenue AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
           CAST(unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * quantity AS revenue
    FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders
    WHERE date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
)
SELECT month,
       price_quartile,
       SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM order_revenue o
JOIN base_price b ON o.product_id = b.product_id
GROUP BY month, price_quartile
ORDER BY month, price_quartile;

Q20.purpose: Landing 404s per session by source for August and September 2026
Q20.sql:
SELECT wt.source,
       date_format(to_date(wt.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT wt.landing_404s) AS landing_404s,
       COUNT(DISTINCT wt.sessions) AS sessions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT wt.landing_404s) / COUNT(DISTINCT wt.sessions) AS landing_404s_per_session
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.web_traffic wt
WHERE wt.date >= '2026-08-01' AND wt.date < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY wt.source, date_format(to_date(wt.date), 'yyyy-MM')
